post.text: The issue began when access via Waiohine Valley Rd was blocked after a nearby landowner objected to public use of a track that crosses private land. Investigations (including some very soggy fieldwork!) confirmed that a river-based legal access route wasn’t a practical alternative.

source.agency_name: Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa (Outdoor Access Commission)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
